huawei-vrp:
acl name EDGE-IN advance
 rule 10 permit tcp source 10.10.0.0 0.0.255.255 destination 192.0.2.10 0.0.0.0 destination-port eq 443 logging
 rule 20 deny ip source any destination any
quit
h3c-comware:
acl advanced name EDGE-IN
 rule 10 permit tcp source 10.10.0.0 0.0.255.255 destination 192.0.2.10 0.0.0.0 destination-port eq 443 logging
 rule 20 deny ip source any destination any
quit
juniper-junos:
set firewall family inet filter EDGE-IN term rule-10 from protocol tcp
set firewall family inet filter EDGE-IN term rule-10 from source-address 10.10.0.0/16
set firewall family inet filter EDGE-IN term rule-10 from destination-address 192.0.2.10/32
set firewall family inet filter EDGE-IN term rule-10 from destination-port 443
set firewall family inet filter EDGE-IN term rule-10 then log
set firewall family inet filter EDGE-IN term rule-10 then accept
set firewall family inet filter EDGE-IN term rule-20 then discard
arista-eos:
ip access-list EDGE-IN
 10 permit tcp 10.10.0.0/16 host 192.0.2.10 eq 443 log
 20 deny ip any any
exit
